title: [756] Sentry Safe Cut in Half FAST!
summary: LockPickingLawyer shows a Sentry fire safe being cut in half with a saw in a few minutes. It is a short demonstration that these safes offer little protection against a determined thief.
why: Used to illustrate that fire safes protect against fire and not theft, and that brute force often defeats low-security containers.

quote.text: For surprise of tool used the saw vs safe are the best
